metadata.title: Antoine Ghigny · Bespoke Web Design & Tech Solutions
metadata.description: Bespoke website and tech solutions for freelancers and SMEs. Based in Nivelles, Belgium.

hero.description: From an optimized professional showcase to a personalized application. I develop the solution you need, without complexity.
hero.tech_argument: Speed: +20% potential conversions. Savings: ~€600/year vs agency fees.

artisan.title: One dedicated expert for your project.
artisan.content: I'm Antoine Ghigny. Not an impersonal agency — your dedicated tech partner. I transform your business needs into high-performance tools, with a craftsman's attention to detail and the power of AI.
artisan.roi_stat: A site that loads in 0.8s means up to 20% more forms filled — and ~€600/year saved vs. agency maintenance fees.

professionalism.label: Immediate Credibility
professionalism.title: A site that reassures your clients and reflects your expertise. <highlight>Stop letting</highlight> a poor image lose you contracts.

trust.label: Guaranteed Efficiency
trust.title: Bespoke tools to automate your tasks. <highlight>Stop wasting hours</highlight> on what a machine can do for you.

performance.label: Dedicated Expert
performance.title: A single agile partner for <highlight>fast</highlight> solutions without technical jargon.

design.label: Craftsmanship
design.title: A craft approach where every detail matters. <highlight>Your project</highlight> deserves special attention.

client.description: Nobody knows your business better than you. You know what your clients are looking for and what convinces them.

my.description: I turn all of that into a site or a tool that works for you: visible on Google, clear for your visitors and simplifying your daily life.

privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is an absolute priority. We process your information in accordance with the GDPR in force in Belgium.

data.title: Collected Data
data.content: This website does not have a contact form and does not actively collect any personal data. When you contact us via WhatsApp or Email, we only process the information you choose to provide to respond to your inquiry.

rights.label: Your Rights
rights.title: Access & Rectification
rights.content: You have the right to access, rectify, and erase your data. Contact us for any request at antoine@ghigny.be.

cookies.title: Cookie Management
cookies.content: We use essential technical cookies. No advertising cookies are placed without your explicit consent.
